source_text: Ῥουστικὸς ἔπαρχος εἶπεν· Ποῦ συνέρχεσθε; Ἰουστῖνος εἶπεν· Ἔνθα ἑκάστῳ προαίρεσις καὶ δύναμίς ἐστι. Πάντως γὰρ νομίζεις ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ συνέρχεσθαι ἡμᾶς πάντας; Οὐχ οὕτως ἔχει· διότι ὁ θεὸς τῶν Χριστιανῶν τόπῳ οὐ περιγράφεται, ἀλλὰ ἀόρατος ὢν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν πληροῖ καὶ πανταχοῦ ὑπὸ τῶν πιστῶν προσκυνεῖται καὶ δοξάζεται. Ῥουστικὸς ἔπαρχος εἶπεν· Εἰπέ, ποῦ συνέρχεσθε ἢ εἰς ποῖον τόπον ἀθροίζεις τοὺς μαθητάς σου; Ἰουστῖνος εἶπεν· Ἐγὼ ἐπάνω μένω τινὸς Μαρτίνου τοῦ Τιμοθίνου βαλανείου καὶ παρὰ πάντα τὸν χρόνον τοῦτον (ἐπεδήμησα δὲ τῇ Ῥωμαίων πόλει τοῦτο δεύτερον) καὶ οὐ γινώσκω ἄλλην τινὰ συνέλευσιν εἰ μὴ τὴν ἐκείνου. Καὶ εἴ τις ἐβούλετο ἀφικνεῖσθαι παρ᾽ ἐμοί, ἐκοινώνουν αὐτῷ τῶν τῆς ἀληθείας λόγων. Ῥουστικὸς εἶπεν· Οὐκοῦν ἄρα σὺ Χριστιανὸς εἶ; Ἰουστῖνος εἶπεν· Ναί, Χριστιανός εἰμι.
pass_a_gloss: Rusticus the prefect said: Where do you come together? Justin said: Wherever there is for each one purpose and power. For you surely think that we all come together at the same place? It is not so; for the God of the Christians is not bounded by place, but though unseen he fills the heaven and the earth and in every place is worshiped and glorified by the believers. Rusticus the prefect said: Tell me, where do you come together or into what place do you collect your disciples? Justin said: I am lodging above the bathhouse of a certain Martinus son of Timothinus, and during all this time — for I am residing in the city of the Romans this second time — I know no other meeting except the one there. And if anyone desired to come to me, I imparted to him the words of the truth. Rusticus said: Then are you a Christian? Justin said: Yes, I am a Christian.
pass_b_english: Rusticus the prefect said, Where do you meet together? Justin said, Wherever suits each person and is possible for him. For you suppose, no doubt, that we all meet in one and the same spot? It is not so, for the God of the Christians is not confined by any place, but though unseen he fills heaven and earth (Jeremiah 23:24) and in every place is worshiped and glorified by those who believe.

Rusticus the prefect said, Tell me, where do you meet, and in what place do you gather your disciples? Justin said, I am staying above the bathhouse of a certain Martinus, son of Timothinus, and throughout all this time — for this is my second stay in the city of Rome — I know of no other gathering except the one there. And if anyone wished to come to me, I shared with him the teachings of the truth. Rusticus said, Then are you a Christian? Justin said, Yes, I am a Christian.

choices.term: Ἔνθα ἑκάστῳ προαίρεσις καὶ δύναμίς ἐστι
choices.english: wherever each person finds it suitable and possible
choices.why: dative ἑκάστῳ with ἐστι gives to each one, and προαίρεσις καὶ δύναμις pairs willingness with means rather than naming a fixed hall
rejected: where choice and power is to each

choices.english: is not confined by any place
choices.why: dative τόπῳ is instrumental or of respect with passive περιγράφεται, denying spatial limitation of God

choices.term: ἐκοινώνουν αὐτῷ τῶν τῆς ἀληθείας λόγων
choices.english: I shared with him the teachings of the truth
choices.why: imperfect ἐκοινώνουν marks repeated action and the genitive marks the thing shared, with dative αὐτῷ as recipient
rejected: I communicated him of the words
